text:
Olivia (People Ops): Quick sync  Sana accepted but is in process of changing status from F-1 OPT to H-1B and expects EAD to expire 2026-09-02. She asked whether we can start 2026-08-25 and how to handle benefits if H-1B approval is delayed.
Marcus (Hiring Manager): Team ramp starts 9/1 but we can start earlier. Would prefer 8/25 if payroll can be set.
Sana (Candidate): I have current OPT EAD card valid through 9/02. My attorney plans H-1B COS filing; unsure if H-1B will be approved before my EAD expiration. I can start on 8/25 and present EAD in person.
Priya (Immigration Counsel): An unexpired EAD on the hire date is acceptable for I-9. For timely-filed EAD renewals, USCIS historically provided an automatic extension for some categories, but H-1B COS timing differs. We should not assume a receipt will fully authorize beyond employer discretion.
Josh (Payroll): If she presents the EAD on 8/25, we can run payroll. We'll set a reverification reminder 30 days before 9/02. If no new auth arrives, payroll must stop. Also need SSN on file  please confirm.
Marta (Benefits): Carriers enroll based on payroll roster. If she is on payroll effective 8/25, benefits can be effective then. If authorization lapses and employment ends, coverage termination rules apply; employee may be eligible for COBRA.
Olivia (People Ops): Action items: 1) Sana upload EAD + passport to secure portal. 2) Priya to confirm receipt-rule applicability for OPT-to-H1B COS in our last memo. 3) Josh to prepare payroll stop/reverification checklist. 4) Marta to prepare benefits memo about effective dates and COBRA.
onboard-bot: Reminder: upload documents via secure HR portal only. Do not post PII here.
Sana (Candidate): Uploaded EAD & passport to portal. I do have an SSN from OPT.
Priya (Immigration Counsel): Reviewed uploaded EAD. Category is c(3)(A) OPT; for initial H-1B COS filings the automatic extension of employment while I-485/I-765 receipts apply is different. My recommendation: proceed with hire on 8/25 based on current EAD but treat any EAD-receipt as non-guaranteed. We'll plan to reverify if H-1B approval comes through.
Josh (Payroll): Confirmed SSN in HRIS. I'll enable payroll effective 8/25 and add a reverification task for 8/10 to check filings. If we get an EAD receipt only, legal must approve continued payroll.
Marta (Benefits): Drafted a short FAQ for Sana: benefits effective 8/25, premiums follow payroll; if employment ends due to lost auth coverage ends and COBRA options follow. Sending via DM.
Marcus (Hiring Manager): Team flexible if we need a short delay. Thanks everyone  excited to get Sana started.
Olivia (People Ops): Closing  will update offer in Greenhouse to include "contingent on acceptable work authorization documents on or before start date" and will send the checklist. Sana, welcome aboard and ping me if anything changes.
Sana (Candidate): Thank you all  appreciate the clarity and will update if anything changes. :smile:
